# Deviload 2.13.0

**Devil Music without dropouts, and with everything you already listen to.** Songs play through to the end, your YouTube Music and Spotify libraries come with you, the microphone tells you what is playing nearby, and the music goes to your TV or speaker.

- Songs no longer stop at 30–40 %. When YouTube slows down or refuses a stream, the player continues from a reserve copy where it stopped, far seeks land where you clicked, and the next song is ready on time.
- Sign in to YouTube in music settings and Devil Music uses your account only when YouTube limits or refuses guest playback. The sign-in stays on this computer: listening rooms, the phone remote, backups and diagnostics never get it. The music cache now keeps 1 GB by default, so songs you play again start at once without asking YouTube.
- Bring your music: read your YouTube Music liked songs and playlists through that sign-in, or sign in to Spotify to bring Liked Songs and your playlists, private ones included. You check every match before anything is added.
- The microphone button in the search recognizes a song playing nearby and finds it here. Only a fingerprint of the sound is sent for recognition, never the recording.
- Cast to a TV or speaker with Chromecast or DLNA on your Wi-Fi. The player here keeps the queue, lyrics and history while the device plays.

### Devil Music

Playback speed is one click away in More, with a badge beside the player when it is not normal, and the [ and ] keys step it down and up. Songs on your computer stored without loss (FLAC, ALAC, WAV) show a Lossless mark.

The music video plays in the mini player too, in step with the song, and a label video YouTube will not stream with sound now shows its picture while the song plays.

A local control API for stream overlays, Stream Deck and scripts can be turned on in music settings. It listens on this computer only, needs the token shown there, and web pages cannot steer the player through it.

### Fixes

Clicking anywhere on the play orb, not just its centre, plays and pauses, in the player and the mini player. Liking a song inside an album keeps your place in the list. Lyrics no longer jump back and forth on songs with short pauses between lines. A YouTube sign-in that YouTube has ended is shown as signed out instead of looking signed in.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
